Two <s>palas</s> of <s>pippalī</s> (long pepper) powder mixed — this is <s>Sarveśvara</s> preparation;
two <s>guñjā</s> doses should be licked with honey — it destroys the circle of <s>kuṣṭha</s> (skin diseases). // Rmañj_6.238 //

children.text: vākucī caiva dārū ca karṣamātraṃ vicūrṇitam /
children.translated_text: <s>Vākucī</s> (Psoralea) and <s>dārū</s> (Berberis), one <s>karṣa</s> measure, should be powdered;
one should lick it with <s>eraṇḍa</s> (castor) oil as the after-drink — it brings comfort. // Rmañj_6.239 //
When there is excess of blood, bloodletting (<s>sirāmokṣa</s>) should be performed on the foot, arm, and forehead,

children.text: kartavyo dṛṣṭirogeṣu kuṣṭhināṃ ca viśeṣataḥ // Rmañj_6.240 //
children.translated_text: especially for those suffering from eye diseases and for those afflicted with <s>kuṣṭha</s> (skin diseases). // Rmañj_6.240 //
For a strong person with abundant <s>doṣa</s> (humoral vitiation), who is in the prime of life,
the authorities prescribe one <s>prastha</s> as the measure for bloodletting. // Rmañj_6.241 //

children.text: vyabhre varṣāsu vidyāttu grīṣmakāle tu śītale /
children.translated_text: On a cloudless day in the rainy season, during the cool time in summer,
and at midday in the winter season — these are the three prescribed times for surgical [bloodletting]. // Rmañj_6.242 //
<s>Tāleśvararasa</s> (The Lord-of-Tāla Preparation) (1)
Twelve <s>karṣas</s> of <s>tāla</s> (orpiment), soaked in <s>kūṣmāṇḍa</s> (ash-gourd) juice,

children.text: svedayed dolikāyantre yāvattoyaṃ na vidyate // Rmañj_6.243 //
children.translated_text: should be steamed in a swing-apparatus (<s>dolāyantra</s>) until no water remains. // Rmañj_6.243 //
Afterwards one should dry it in a mortar, add two <s>karṣas</s> of mercury,

children.text: gharṣayed bahudhā tattu yāvatkajjalikā bhavet // Rmañj_6.244 //
children.translated_text: and grind it repeatedly until it becomes a black paste (<s>kajjalikā</s>). // Rmañj_6.244 //
Milk of <s>snuhī</s> (Euphorbia), milk of <s>ravi</s> (arka, Calotropis), goat's [milk], <s>gokṣura</s> (Tribulus), <s>vākucī</s> (Psoralea),
<s>pātālagaruḍī</s>, <s>aṅkola</s> (Alangium), <s>cakramarda</s> (Cassia tora), and <s>hijjala</s> (Barringtonia); // Rmañj_6.245 //
<s>kumārī</s> (aloe), <s>unmatta</s> (Datura), <s>bhallātaka</s> (Semecarpus), <s>triphalā</s> (the three fruits), water, and <s>punarnava</s> (Boerhavia);

children.text: nimbatvag ebhir bhaiṣajyaiḥ puṭanācca trayaṃ trayam // Rmañj_6.246 //
children.translated_text: <s>nimba</s> (neem) bark — with these medicines, three calcinations (<s>puṭana</s>) each [should be given]. // Rmañj_6.246 //
Six <s>karṣas</s> of the <s>kalikā</s> (paste) powder should be placed in a pot;

children.text: caturthāṃśamadhaḥ sthāpyaṃ madhye sthāpyaṃ tu tālakam // Rmañj_6.247 //
children.translated_text: one-fourth should be placed below, and the <s>tālaka</s> (orpiment) should be placed in the middle. // Rmañj_6.247 //
Then all the powder should be placed on top carefully;
the pot should be filled up to the neck with the juice of <s>kumārī</s> (aloe). // Rmañj_6.248 //
Then one should seal it with a firm lid carefully,

children.text: tasyopari śilāṃ dattvā dṛḍhā na ca caledyathā // Rmañj_6.249 //
children.translated_text: and placing a stone on top of it, [ensure] it is firm so it does not move. // Rmañj_6.249 //
Four <s>yāmas</s> (12 hours) with a lamp-fire, and twenty <s>yāmas</s> (60 hours) with strong fire;
when self-cooled, one should extract it — this is <s>Tāleśvara</s> preparation for <s>kuṣṭha</s> (skin disease). // Rmañj_6.250 //
This supreme destroyer of <s>kuṣṭha</s> was proclaimed by <s>Bhairavānandayogin</s>;
the physician should prescribe as diet <s>mudga</s> (mung bean), water, and rice. // Rmañj_6.251 //

children.text: sūto dvau valgujā trīṇi kaṇā viśvā trikaṃ trikam // Rmañj_6.252 //
children.translated_text: Mercury two [parts], <s>valgujā</s> (Psoralea) three, <s>kaṇā</s> (long pepper), <s>viśvā</s> (dry ginger), and <s>trika</s> (the three spices) — three each; // Rmañj_6.252 //
one and a half of <s>brahmaputra</s> (orpiment), four of <s>marica</s> (black pepper);
one each of <s>nimba</s> (neem), <s>dhattūra</s> (Datura) seeds, and three of <s>gandhaka</s> (sulphur); // Rmañj_6.253 //
ten parts each of <s>jātī</s> (nutmeg), <s>ṭaṅkaṇa</s> (borax), and <s>tāla</s> (orpiment) are prescribed;
all should be ground skillfully and saturated with the juice of <s>amṛtā</s> (Tinospora). // Rmañj_6.254 //
Having dried it seven times, one should administer it with <s>dhattūra</s> (Datura);

children.text: saṃmardya golakaṃ sārdraṃ dhattūrair veṣṭayeddalaiḥ // Rmañj_6.255 //
children.translated_text: grinding it into a moist bolus, one should wrap it with <s>dhattūra</s> leaves. // Rmañj_6.255 //
One should wrap that in cow dung and cook it in a <s>kukkuṭa</s>-type calcination (<s>puṭa</s>);

children.text: rasaḥ kuṣṭhaharaḥ sevyaḥ sarvadā bhojanapriyaiḥ // Rmañj_6.256 //
children.translated_text: this preparation destroys <s>kuṣṭha</s> (skin diseases) and should always be used by those who enjoy food. // Rmañj_6.256 //
<s>Svarṇakṣīrīrasa</s> (The Golden-Milk Preparation)
Five <s>palas</s> of <s>hemāhvā</s> (the golden one, i.e. <s>svarṇakṣīrī</s>) should be put into a pot of buttermilk and cooked;

children.text: takre jīrṇe samuddhṛtya punaḥ kṣīraghaṭe pacet // Rmañj_6.257 //
children.translated_text: when the buttermilk is consumed, one should take it out and again cook it in a pot of milk. // Rmañj_6.257 //
When the milk is consumed, one should take it out, wash it, and dry it;
that powder, five <s>palas</s>, and two <s>palas</s> of <s>marica</s> (black pepper), // Rmañj_6.258 //

children.text: palaikaṃ mūrchitaṃ sūtam ekīkṛtvā ca bhakṣayet /
children.translated_text: and one <s>pala</s> of <s>mūrcchita</s> (swooned/processed) mercury — combining all, one should consume it;
one <s>niṣka</s> dose [cures] one afflicted with <s>suptikuṣṭha</s> (numbness-type skin disease) — this is the <s>Svarṇakṣīrīrasa</s>. // Rmañj_6.259 //
<s>Śūlagajakesarīrasa</s> (The Lion-of-Colic-Elephants Preparation)

children.text: śuddhasūtaṃ dvidhā gandhaṃ yāmaikaṃ mardayed dṛḍham /
children.translated_text: Purified mercury and twice [its weight of] sulphur should be ground firmly for one <s>yāma</s> (three hours);

children.text: tāmrabhasma dvayostulyaṃ sampuṭe taṃ nirodhayet // Rmañj_6.260 //
children.translated_text: equal [quantity of] <s>tāmra bhasma</s> (copper ash) to both — one should confine it in a crucible (<s>sampuṭa</s>). // Rmañj_6.260 //
Having placed salt above and below, the physician should keep it in an earthen vessel;

children.text: tato gajapuṭe paktvā svāṅgaśītaṃ samuddharet // Rmañj_6.261 //
children.translated_text: then cooking it in an elephant-dung calcination (<s>gajapuṭa</s>), one should extract it when self-cooled. // Rmañj_6.261 //
One should powder the crucible contents finely; two <s>guñjā</s> doses on a betel leaf —
one should consume it for relief of colic pain (<s>śūla</s>), together with <s>hiṅgu</s> (asafoetida), <s>śuṇṭhī</s> (dry ginger), and <s>jīraka</s> (cumin). // Rmañj_6.262 //
One should drink one <s>karṣa</s> of powder made from <s>vacā</s> (calamus) and <s>marica</s> (black pepper) with warm water;
it cures even incurable colic — this preparation is [called] <s>Śūlakesarī</s> (the Lion against Colic). // Rmañj_6.263 //

children.text: vyāyāmaṃ maithunaṃ madyaṃ lavaṇaṃ kaṭukāni ca /
children.translated_text: Exercise, sexual intercourse, liquor, salt, and pungent substances,
suppression of natural urges, and retention of semen — a man suffering from colic should avoid [these]. // Rmañj_6.264 //
<s>Brahmarasa</s> (The Brahma Preparation)
One part of processed (<s>mūrcchita</s>) mercury, <s>gandhaka</s> (sulphur), <s>valguja</s> (Psoralea), and <s>citraka</s> (Plumbago);
powder of <s>brahma</s> seeds (Datura), one-twelfth part each; // Rmañj_6.265 //
thirty parts of <s>guḍa</s> (jaggery) — pills should be made with honey;
this is named <s>Brahmarasa</s>, the destroyer of even the sin of <s>brahmahatyā</s> (killing a Brahmin) [i.e., the worst of skin diseases]. // Rmañj_6.266 //
By consuming two <s>niṣkas</s>, it destroys numbness (<s>prasupti</s>) and the circle of <s>kuṣṭha</s> (skin diseases);
afterwards one should grind the root of <s>pātālagaruḍī</s> in water and drink it. // Rmañj_6.267 //
<s>Indudhararasa</s> (The Moon-Bearer Preparation)

children.text: śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ samaṃ gandhaṃ tutthaṃ ca mṛtatāmrakam /
children.translated_text: Purified mercury, equal [weight of] sulphur, <s>tuttha</s> (copper sulphate), and killed copper,
ground with a decoction of <s>vākucī</s> (Psoralea) for one day and made into pills; // Rmañj_6.268 //
one <s>niṣka</s> dose should always be eaten — <s>Indudhararasa</s> destroys <s>śveta</s> (leukoderma);
one <s>karṣa</s> of <s>vākucī</s> (Psoralea) oil mixed with honey should be taken as after-drink. // Rmañj_6.269 //
<s>Pāribhadrarasa</s> (The Pāribhadra Preparation)
Processed (<s>mūrcchita</s>) mercury, <s>dhātrīphala</s> (āmalaka, Indian gooseberry), and <s>nimba</s> (neem),
in equal parts — should be ground for one day with a decoction of <s>khadira</s> (Acacia catechu) and consumed;
one <s>niṣka</s> dose — this preparation named <s>Pāribhadra</s> destroys <s>dadru</s> (ringworm) and <s>kuṣṭha</s> (skin diseases). // Rmañj_6.270 //
<s>Śvetāririsa</s> (The Enemy-of-White Preparation)

children.text: śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ samaṃ gandhaṃ triphalābhraṃ ca vākucī /
children.translated_text: Purified mercury, equal [weight of] sulphur, <s>triphalā</s> (the three fruits), mica, <s>vākucī</s> (Psoralea),

children.text: bhallātaṃ ca śilā kṛṣṇā nimbabījaṃ samaṃ samam // Rmañj_6.271 //
children.translated_text: <s>bhallātaka</s> (Semecarpus), <s>kṛṣṇā śilā</s> (black bitumen/shilajit), and <s>nimba</s> (neem) seeds — equal parts of each. // Rmañj_6.271 //
One should grind them with the juices of <s>bhṛṅgarāja</s> (Eclipta), grinding and drying again and again;

children.text: itthaṃ kuryāt trisaptāhaṃ rasaṃ śvetāriko bhavet // Rmañj_6.272 //
children.translated_text: thus one should do this for three weeks — the preparation becomes <s>Śvetāri</s> (the enemy of white). // Rmañj_6.272 //

body.translated_text: One <s>niṣka</s> should be eaten with honey and ghee — it destroys <s>śvetakuṣṭha</s> (leukoderma). // Rmañj_6.273 //

children.translated_text: <s>Kālāgnirudrarasa</s> (The Fire-of-Time-Rudra Preparation)
Mercury, mica, ash of copper and iron (<s>tīkṣṇa</s>), <s>mākṣika</s> (iron pyrite), and <s>gandhaka</s> (sulphur);
the preparation should be ground for one day with the juices of <s>vandhyākarkoṭakī</s> (a variety of Momordica). // Rmañj_6.274 //
Having placed it in the tuber of <s>vandhyākarkoṭakī</s> and coating with clay on the outside,

children.text: bhūdharākhye puṭe pācyaṃ dinaikaṃ tu vicūrṇayet // Rmañj_6.275 //
children.translated_text: it should be cooked in a <s>bhūdhara</s>-type calcination for one day, then powdered. // Rmañj_6.275 //

children.text: daśamāṃśaṃ viṣaṃ yojyaṃ māṣamātraṃ ca bhakṣayet /
children.translated_text: One-tenth part of <s>viṣa</s> (aconite) should be added; one should consume one <s>māṣa</s> dose;
this <s>Kālāgnirudra</s> preparation eliminates <s>visarpa</s> (erysipelas/herpes) within ten days. // Rmañj_6.276 //
One should prescribe <s>pippalī</s> (long pepper) with honey as the after-drink.
<s>Makaradhvajarasa</s> (The Crocodile-Banner Preparation)
Mercury eight times [the weight of] gold should be ground with twice [its weight of] sulphur; // Rmañj_6.277 //
with the flowers of red cotton and [juice of] <s>kumārī</s> (aloe) for three days; then

children.text: śuṣkaṃ kācaghaṭe ruddhvā vālukāyantragaṃ haṭhāt // Rmañj_6.278 //
children.translated_text: when dry, it should be confined in a glass vessel and [placed] in a sand-bath apparatus by force; // Rmañj_6.278 //
one should make an ash of the lord of mercury resembling the rays of a new sun;
one part of this, and four resplendent parts of camphor; // Rmañj_6.279 //
<s>lavaṅga</s> (clove), <s>marica</s> (black pepper), <s>jātīphala</s> (nutmeg), in the measure of camphor;
one should add <s>mṛganābhi</s> (musk) measured at one <s>gadyāṇa</s>; // Rmañj_6.280 //
the preparation, finely ground, becomes the glorious <s>Makaradhvaja</s>;
one or two <s>valla</s> doses of it, combined with betel leaf, // Rmañj_6.281 //
one should eat sweet, unctuous, light meat free from wind (<s>vāta</s>),

children.text: śṛtaṃ śītaṃ sitāyuktaṃ dugdhaṃ godhūmam ājyakam // Rmañj_6.282 //
children.translated_text: cooked, cooled, [and] milk with sugar, wheat, and ghee, // Rmañj_6.282 //
<s>māṣa</s> (black gram) and other food preparations, and various wines;
it produces digestive fire and strength in men, and destroys wrinkles and grey hair. // Rmañj_6.283 //
It generates intellect, longevity, and radiance, and is a great arouser of desire;

children.text: abhyāsāt sādhakaḥ strīṇāṃ śataṃ jayati nityaśaḥ // Rmañj_6.284 //
children.translated_text: through regular practice, the practitioner conquers a hundred women always. // Rmañj_6.284 //

children.text: ratikāle ratānte vā punaḥ sevyo rasottamaḥ /
children.translated_text: At the time of lovemaking or after its conclusion, this supreme preparation should be taken again;
it certainly causes the exhaustion of passion in women. // Rmañj_6.285 //
Artificial poison, plant-based poison, animal-based poison, and aquatic poison —

children.text: na vikārāya bhavati sādhakānāṃ ca vatsarāt // Rmañj_6.286 //
children.translated_text: [none] produces any adverse effect in practitioners after a year [of use]. // Rmañj_6.286 //
Just as <s>Mṛtyuñjaya</s> (the Conqueror of Death, i.e., Śiva) conquers death for embodied beings through practice,
so too this [preparation] destroys old age and death for the lord of practitioners. // Rmañj_6.287 //
<s>Madanakāmadevarasa</s> (The Madana-Kāmadeva Preparation)

children.text: tāraṃ vajraṃ suvarṇaṃ ca tāmraṃ ca sūtagandhakam /
children.translated_text: Silver, diamond, gold, copper, mercury, and sulphur,

children.text: lohaṃ ca kramavṛddhāni kuryādetāni mātrayā // Rmañj_6.288 //
children.translated_text: and iron — one should prepare these in progressively increasing measures; // Rmañj_6.288 //
grinding with the juices of <s>kanyakā</s> (aloe), one should place it in a glass vessel;
sealed, one should keep it inside a larger pot filled with <s>saindhava</s> (rock salt). // Rmañj_6.289 //
One should seal the outer pot properly and then place it on a furnace;

children.text: vahniṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ kuryāddinaikaṃ tata uddharet // Rmañj_6.290 //
children.translated_text: one should apply fire very gradually for one day, then extract it. // Rmañj_6.290 //
When self-cooled, having powdered it, one should saturate it with the milk of <s>arka</s> (Calotropis);

children.text: aśvagandhā ca kaṅkolī vānarī muśalīkṣuraḥ // Rmañj_6.291 //
children.translated_text: <s>aśvagandhā</s> (Withania), <s>kaṅkolī</s> (Piper cubeba), <s>vānarī</s>, <s>muśalī</s> (Curculigo), and <s>kṣura</s> (Hygrophila); // Rmañj_6.291 //
three times it should be saturated with the juice [of these], and [then] with the juice of <s>śatāvarī</s> (Asparagus);

children.text: padmakandakaserūṇāṃ rasair bhāvyaṃ tu ekadhā // Rmañj_6.292 //
children.translated_text: it should be saturated once with the juices of lotus root and <s>serū</s> (lotus stalk). // Rmañj_6.292 //
<s>kastūrī</s> (musk), <s>vyoṣa</s> (the three pungents), camphor, <s>kaṅkola</s> (cubeb), <s>elā</s> (cardamom), and <s>lavaṅga</s> (clove);
powder measured at one-eighth of the previous powder should be mixed in. // Rmañj_6.293 //

children.text: sarvaiḥ samāṃ śarkarāṃ ca dattvā śāṇonmitaṃ dadet /
children.translated_text: Adding sugar equal to all, one should give one <s>śāṇa</s> dose;
with two <s>palas</s> of cow's milk — for one who follows a sweet diet. // Rmañj_6.294 //

children.text: asya prabhāvāt saundaryyaṃ balaṃ tejo vivardhate /
children.translated_text: By its potency, beauty, strength, and vigour increase;
one enjoys many young women, and no loss of virility occurs. // Rmañj_6.295 //
<s>Pūrṇendurasa</s> (The Full-Moon Preparation)
Purified mercury should be ground with the extracts of <s>śālmalī</s> (silk-cotton tree) for a fortnight;

children.text: yāmadvayaṃ pacedājye vastre baddhvātha mardayet // Rmañj_6.296 //
children.translated_text: then it should be cooked in ghee for two <s>yāmas</s> (six hours), tied in a cloth, and then ground again. // Rmañj_6.296 //
Having ground it for one day with <s>śālmalī</s> extracts, pills should be made;
one should wrap them in <s>nāgavallī</s> (betel) leaves and place them in a glass vessel. // Rmañj_6.297 //
The vessel, filled with <s>śālmalī</s> extracts, should be cooked for two <s>yāmas</s> (six hours)

children.text: vālukāyaṃtramadhye tu drave jīrṇe samuddharet // Rmañj_6.298 //
children.translated_text: in a sand-bath apparatus; when the liquid is consumed, one should extract it. // Rmañj_6.298 //
Two <s>guñjā</s> doses should be eaten in the morning, between <s>nāgavallī</s> (betel) leaves;

children.text: muśalīṃ sasitāṃ kṣīraiḥ palaikaṃ pāyayedanu // Rmañj_6.299 //
children.translated_text: afterwards one should drink one <s>pala</s> of <s>muśalī</s> (Curculigo) with sugar in milk. // Rmañj_6.299 //
This preparation, named <s>Pūrṇendu</s> (Full Moon), properly produces virility;

children.text: kāminīnāṃ sahasraikaṃ naraḥ kāmayate dhruvam // Rmañj_6.300 //
children.translated_text: a man certainly desires a thousand <s>kāminī</s> (passionate women). // Rmañj_6.300 //
<s>Kāminīmadabhañjanarasa</s> (The Destroyer-of-Women's-Pride Preparation)

children.text: śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ samaṃ gandhaṃ tryahaṃ kahlārajadravaiḥ /
children.translated_text: Purified mercury and equal [weight of] sulphur, ground for three days with the juices of <s>kahlāra</s> (white water-lily);

children.text: marditaṃ vālukāyantre yāmaiḥ kūpīgataṃ pacet // Rmañj_6.301 //
children.translated_text: in a sand-bath apparatus, placed in a <s>kūpī</s> (flask), it should be cooked for [several] <s>yāmas</s>. // Rmañj_6.301 //
It should be saturated with the juices of <s>raktāṅga</s> (red sandalwood or saffron) for one day, mixed with sugar;
one should eat it as desired, and afterwards one enjoys a hundred passionate women. // Rmañj_6.302 //
<s>Madanodayarasa</s> (The Arising-of-Passion Preparation)
Purified <s>sūta</s> (mercury) and equal [quantity of] <s>gandha</s> (sulfur), with the juices of red lotus petals,

children.text: yāmaṃ mardyaṃ punargandhaṃ pūrvād ardhaṃ viniṣkṣipet // Rmañj_6.303 //
children.translated_text: should be ground for one <s>yāma</s> (three hours); then again <s>gandha</s> (sulfur), half of the previous [amount], should be added. // Rmañj_6.303 //
One should grind that for one day; then again grind with <s>gandha</s> (sulfur)

children.text: pūrvadrāvairdinaikaṃ tu kācakupyāṃ nirudhya ca // Rmañj_6.304 //
children.translated_text: with the previous liquids for one day, and seal it in a glass bottle. // Rmañj_6.304 //
Cooked in a <s>vālukāyantra</s> (sand bath) for one day, having taken it out, one should consume it —

children.text: pañcaguñjā sitā sārddhaṃ raso'yaṃ madanodayaḥ // Rmañj_6.305 //
children.translated_text: five <s>guñjā</s> [weight] with sugar; this <s>rasa</s> is [called] <s>Madanodaya</s> (Arousal of Passion). // Rmañj_6.305 //
<s>Vānarī</s> seeds with root, <s>muśalī</s> (Curculigo), equal [amount of] sugar —
that should be drunk with cow's milk, half a <s>pala</s> as an adjuvant. // Rmañj_6.306 //
<s>Anaṅgasundara Rasa</s> (Beautiful Cupid Preparation)

children.text: paladvayaṃ dvayaṃ śuddhaṃ pāradaṃ gandhakaṃ tathā /
children.translated_text: Two <s>palas</s> each of purified <s>pārada</s> (mercury) and <s>gandhaka</s> (sulfur),
one <s>karṣa</s> of calcined <s>hema</s> (gold), one <s>pala</s> of calcined <s>tāmra</s> (copper), // Rmañj_6.307 //
four <s>niṣkas</s> of calcined <s>tāra</s> (silver) — should be ground with <s>pañcāmṛta</s> (five nectars) for a day;

children.text: ruddhvā tu vai puṭe paścāddinaikaṃ tu samuddharet // Rmañj_6.308 //
children.translated_text: having sealed it, one should then calcine in a <s>puṭa</s> and extract after one day. // Rmañj_6.308 //
Having ground with <s>pañcāmṛta</s>, one should make a pill the shape of a jujube fruit;
this, named <s>Anaṅgasundara</s>, is supremely nourishment-giving. // Rmañj_6.309 //
<s>Kāmeśvara Rasa</s> (Lord of Desire Preparation)

children.text: samyaṅmāritamabhrakaṃ kaṭphalaṃ kuṣṭhāśvagandhāmṛtā methī mocaraso vidārimuśalī gokṣūrakaṃ kṣūrakam /
children.translated_text: Properly calcined <s>abhraka</s> (ite), <s>kaṭphala</s> (Myrica), <s>kuṣṭha</s> (Saussurea), <s>aśvagandhā</s> (Withania), <s>amṛtā</s> (Tinospora), <s>methī</s> (fenugreek), <s>mocarasa</s> (Bombax resin), <s>vidārī</s> (Pueraria), <s>muśalī</s> (Curculigo), <s>gokṣūraka</s> (Tribulus), <s>kṣūraka</s>,

children.text: rambhākandaśatāvarī hyajamudā māṣāstilā dhānyakaṃ yaṣṭī nāgabalā kacūramadanaṃ jātīphalaṃ saindhavam // Rmañj_6.310 //
children.translated_text: <s>rambhākanda</s> (banana tuber), <s>śatāvarī</s> (Asparagus), <s>ajamudā</s> (celery seeds), <s>māṣa</s> (black gram), <s>tila</s> (sesame), <s>dhānyaka</s> (coriander), <s>yaṣṭī</s> (licorice), <s>nāgabalā</s>, <s>kacūra</s> (Curcuma zedoary), <s>madana</s> (Randia), <s>jātīphala</s> (nutmeg), <s>saindhava</s> (rock salt), // Rmañj_6.310 //

children.text: bhārṅgī karkaṭaśṛṅgikā trikaṭukaṃ jīradvayaṃ citrakaṃ cāturjātapunarnavā gajakaṇā drākṣā śaṭī vāsakam /
children.translated_text: <s>bhārṅgī</s> (Clerodendrum), <s>karkaṭaśṛṅgī</s> (Pistacia), <s>trikaṭuka</s> (three pungents), two kinds of <s>jīra</s> (cumin), <s>citraka</s> (Plumbago), <s>cāturjāta</s> (four spices), <s>punarnavā</s> (Boerhavia), <s>gajakaṇā</s>, <s>drākṣā</s> (grapes), <s>śaṭī</s> (Hedychium), <s>vāsaka</s> (Adhatoda),

children.text: śālmalyandhriphalatrikaṃ kapibhavaṃ bījaṃ samaṃ cūrṇayeccūrṇāṃśā vijayā sitā dviguṇitā madhvājyayoḥ piṇḍitam // Rmañj_6.311 //
children.translated_text: <s>śālmali</s> (silk-cotton) root, <s>triphalā</s> (three fruits), <s>kapibhava</s> (Mucuna) seeds — all equal [parts] should be powdered; powder portions of <s>vijayā</s> (Cannabis) and double the sugar, made into a mass with honey and ghee. // Rmañj_6.311 //

children.text: karṣārddhā guṭikāvaleham athavā sevyaṃ sadā sarvathā peyaṃ kṣīrasitā tu vīryakaraṇaṃ stambho'pyayaṃ kāminī /
children.translated_text: Half a <s>karṣa</s> as a pill or electuary — it should always be taken in every way; to be drunk with milk and sugar, it produces virility, is a <s>stambhana</s> (restrainer), and [pleases] women;

children.text: rāmāvaśyakaraṃ sukhātisukhadaṃ prauḍhāṅganādrāvakam kṣīṇe puṣṭikaraṃ kṣaye kṣayaharaṃ sarvāmayadhvaṃsanam // Rmañj_6.312 //
children.translated_text: it subjugates women, gives the highest pleasure, melts [the hearts of] mature women, nourishes the emaciated, destroys <s>kṣaya</s> (consumption) in consumptive patients, and annihilates all diseases. // Rmañj_6.312 //

It alleviates cough, asthma, and severe diarrhea, kindles weak digestive fire, increases <s>dhātu</s> (bodily tissues), and is the best <s>rasāyana</s> (rejuvenation) — there is nothing superior to this;

children.text: arśāṃsi grahaṇīpramehanicayaśleṣmātiraktapraṇun nityānandakaraṃ viśeṣaviduṣāṃ vācāṃ vilāsodbhavam // Rmañj_6.313 //
children.translated_text: it [cures] hemorrhoids, <s>grahaṇī</s> (sprue), collection of <s>prameha</s> (urinary disorders), excess <s>śleṣma</s> (phlegm), and excess <s>rakta</s> (blood); it bestows eternal bliss and arises from the eloquent speech of the especially learned. // Rmañj_6.313 //

children.text: abhyāsena nihanti mṛtyupalitaṃ kāmeśvaro vatsarāt sarveṣāṃ hitakārako nigaditaḥ śrīvaidyanāthena yaḥ /
children.translated_text: With regular use, <s>Kāmeśvara</s> destroys death and gray hair within a year; it has been declared beneficial for all by the revered <s>Vaidyanātha</s>;

children.text: vṛddhānāṃ madanodayodayakaraḥ prauḍhāṅganāsaṅgame siṃho'yaṃ samadṛṣṭiḥ pratyayakaro bhūpaiḥ sadā sevyatām // Rmañj_6.314 //
children.translated_text: it arouses passion in the elderly, [making them] like a lion in the company of mature women; this [remedy], equal-sighted and confidence-inspiring, should always be taken by kings. // Rmañj_6.314 //
<s>Ajīrṇakaṇṭaka Rasa</s> (Thorn of Indigestion Preparation)

children.text: śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ viṣaṃ gandhaṃ samacūrṇaṃ vicūrṇayet /
children.translated_text: Purified <s>sūta</s> (mercury), <s>viṣa</s> (aconite), <s>gandha</s> (sulfur) — equal powders should be pulverized,
with <s>marica</s> (black pepper) equal in total quantity, with the juice of <s>kaṇṭakārī</s> (Solanum) fruits. // Rmañj_6.315 //
One should grind and triturate all twenty-one times;
one should eat a pill of three <s>guñjā</s> weight for the pacification of all types of <s>ajīrṇa</s> (indigestion). // Rmañj_6.316 //
<s>Udayabhāskara Rasa</s> (Rising Sun Preparation)
<s>Tāmra</s> (copper) calcined with <s>gandhaka</s> (sulfur) — ten parts should be taken;

children.text: ūṣaṇaṃ pañcabhāgaṃ syādamṛtaṃ ca dvibhāgakam // Rmañj_6.317 //
children.translated_text: <s>ūṣaṇa</s> (black pepper) should be five parts, and <s>amṛta</s> (Tinospora) two parts. // Rmañj_6.317 //
All finely powdered, in the dose of one <s>raktikā</s> (seed-weight),
should be given to a <s>kuṣṭha</s> (skin disease) patient properly with an appropriate adjuvant. // Rmañj_6.318 //

children.text: galite sphuṭite caiva viṣūcyāṃ maṇḍale tathā /
children.translated_text: In cases of [skin] erosion, eruptions, <s>visūcikā</s> (cholera), circular [lesions],
for the pacification of the eight [types of] <s>kuṣṭha</s> including <s>vicarcikā</s> (eczema), <s>dadru</s> (ringworm), and <s>pāmā</s> (scabies). // Rmañj_6.319 //
<s>Raudra Rasa</s> (Fierce Preparation)

children.text: śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ samaṃ gandhaṃ mardyaṃ yāmacatuṣṭayam /
children.translated_text: Purified <s>sūta</s> (mercury) and equal <s>gandha</s> (sulfur) should be ground for four <s>yāmas</s> (twelve hours),
combined with the juice of <s>nāgavallī</s> (betel vine), <s>meghanāda</s> (Barleria), and <s>punarnavā</s> (Boerhavia). // Rmañj_6.320 //
Ground in cow's urine mixed with <s>pippalī</s> (long pepper), sealed and given a light <s>puṭa</s> (calcination),

children.text: lihetkṣaudre raso raudro guñjāmātro'rbudaṃ jayet // Rmañj_6.321 //
children.translated_text: one should lick [a dose of] one <s>guñjā</s> weight with honey — this <s>Raudra Rasa</s> conquers <s>arbuda</s> (tumors). // Rmañj_6.321 //
<s>Nityodita Rasa</s> (Ever-Rising Preparation)
Calcined <s>sūta</s> (mercury), <s>arka</s> (calotropis), <s>loha</s> (iron), <s>abhra</s> (mica), <s>viṣa</s> (aconite), and <s>gandha</s> (sulfur) — all in equal parts,
with <s>bhallātaka</s> (Semecarpus) fruit equal to all combined — should be powdered together. // Rmañj_6.322 //
With liquids extracted from <s>sūraṇa</s> (elephant yam) tuber, grind in a mortar for three days;
one should lick one <s>māṣa</s> weight with ghee — this <s>rasa</s> destroys hemorrhoids. // Rmañj_6.323 //
This <s>rasa</s>, named <s>Nityodita</s>, destroys the lineage of diseases born of the rectum;

children.text: haste pāde mukhe nābhyāṃ gudavṛṣaṇayostathā // Rmañj_6.324 //
children.translated_text: [whether] in the hand, foot, mouth, navel, rectum, or testicles — // Rmañj_6.324 //
swelling, heart and side pain — it is beneficial for incurable hemorrhoids;
even for what is incurable, treatment should be undertaken, as declared by <s>Śaṅkara</s>. // Rmañj_6.325 //
<s>Arśakuṭhāra Rasa</s> (Hemorrhoid-Axe Preparation)
One <s>pala</s> of purified <s>sūta</s> (mercury), two <s>palas</s> of purified <s>gandhaka</s> (sulfur),

children.text: mṛtaṃ tāmraṃ mṛtaṃ lohaṃ pratyekaṃ tu palatrayam // Rmañj_6.326 //
children.translated_text: calcined <s>tāmra</s> (copper) and calcined <s>loha</s> (iron) — three <s>palas</s> each. // Rmañj_6.326 //

children.text: tryūṣaṇaṃ lāṅgalī dantī pīlukaṃ citrakaṃ tathā /
children.translated_text: <s>Tryūṣaṇa</s> (three pungents), <s>lāṅgalī</s> (Gloriosa), <s>dantī</s> (Baliospermum), <s>pīluka</s>, and <s>citraka</s> (Plumbago) —

children.text: pratyekaṃ dvipalaṃ yojyaṃ yavakṣāraṃ ca ṭaṅkaṇam // Rmañj_6.327 //
children.translated_text: two <s>palas</s> each should be added, along with <s>yavakṣāra</s> (barley alkali) and <s>ṭaṅkaṇa</s> (borax). // Rmañj_6.327 //
Both [alkali and borax] should be five <s>palas</s> each; <s>saindhava</s> (rock salt) five <s>palas</s>;
twenty-two <s>palas</s> of cow's urine and an equal amount of <s>snuhī</s> (Euphorbia) milk. // Rmañj_6.328 //
All should be cooked on a mild fire in a pot until it forms a solid mass;
one should always eat two <s>māṣa</s> weight — this <s>rasa</s> is the <s>Arśakuṭhāra</s> (Hemorrhoid-Axe). // Rmañj_6.329 //
<s>Vidyādhara Rasa</s> (Celestial-Being Preparation)

children.text: gandhakaṃ tālakaṃ tāpyaṃ mṛtaṃ tāmraṃ manaḥśilā /
children.translated_text: <s>Gandhaka</s> (sulfur), <s>tālaka</s> (orpiment), <s>tāpya</s> (pyrite), calcined <s>tāmra</s> (copper), <s>manaḥśilā</s> (realgar),

children.text: śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ ca tulyāṃśaṃ mardayedbhāvayeddinam // Rmañj_6.330 //
children.translated_text: and purified <s>sūta</s> (mercury) — in equal parts, one should grind and triturate for a day // Rmañj_6.330 //
with a decoction of <s>pippalī</s> (long pepper); one should triturate with the milk of <s>vajrī</s> (Euphorbia);

children.text: vallaṃ ca bhakṣayet kṣaudraiḥ plīhagulmādikaṃ jayet // Rmañj_6.331 //
children.translated_text: one should eat one <s>valla</s> weight with honey — it conquers <s>plīha</s> (splenic disorders) and <s>gulma</s> (abdominal tumors) etc. // Rmañj_6.331 //

children.text: raso vidyādharo nāma godugdhaṃ ca pibedanu /
children.translated_text: This <s>rasa</s> is named <s>Vidyādhara</s>; one should drink cow's milk as an adjuvant.
<s>Vaṅgeśvara Rasa</s> (Lord of Tin Preparation)
One part each of <s>sūta</s> (mercury) <s>bhasma</s> (ash) and <s>vaṅga</s> (tin) <s>bhasma</s> (ash) should be apportioned; // Rmañj_6.332 //

children.text: gandhakaṃ mṛtatāmraṃ ca pratyekaṃ ca caturguṇam /
children.translated_text: <s>gandhaka</s> (sulfur) and calcined <s>tāmra</s> (copper) — four times each;
all should be ground for a day with the milk of <s>arka</s> (Calotropis), and made into a ball. // Rmañj_6.333 //
Having sealed it, it should be cooked in an earthen furnace with one <s>puṭa</s> (calcination) and then extracted;

children.text: evaṃ vaṅgeśvaro nāmnā plīhagulmodaraṃ jayet // Rmañj_6.334 //
children.translated_text: thus, [this preparation] named <s>Vaṅgeśvara</s> conquers splenic disorders, abdominal tumors, and abdominal enlargement. // Rmañj_6.334 //
One should lick two <s>guñjā</s> weight with ghee, [along with] one <s>niṣka</s> of white <s>punarnavā</s> (Boerhavia);

children.text: gavāṃ mūtraiḥ pibeccānu rajanī vā gavāṃ jalaiḥ // Rmañj_6.335 //
children.translated_text: one should drink cow's urine as an adjuvant, or <s>rajanī</s> (turmeric) with cow's urine. // Rmañj_6.335 //
<s>Udarāri Rasa</s> (Enemy of Abdominal Disease Preparation)
<s>Pārada</s> (mercury), <s>śikhituttha</s> (blue vitriol), <s>jaipāla</s> (Croton), and <s>pippalī</s> (long pepper) in equal parts —
with the marrow of <s>āragvadha</s> (Cassia fistula) fruit, one should grind with the milk of <s>vajrī</s> (Euphorbia). // Rmañj_6.336 //
One should eat a pill of one <s>māṣa</s> weight — it cures <s>jalodara</s> (ascites) in women;
the juice of <s>ciñcā</s> (tamarind) fruit [should be taken] as adjuvant; rice with yogurt is the recommended diet;

children.text: jalodaraharaṃ caiva tīvreṇa recanena tu // Rmañj_6.337 //
children.translated_text: it indeed removes <s>jalodara</s> (ascites) through intense purgation. // Rmañj_6.337 //
<s>Pippalī</s> (long pepper), <s>marica</s> (black pepper), <s>tāmra</s> (copper), combined with <s>kāñcanī</s> powder, // Rmañj_6.338 //
should be ground for a day with the milk of <s>snuhī</s> (Euphorbia), [along with] <s>tuttha</s> (blue vitriol) and <s>jaipāla</s> (Croton) seeds;

children.text: niṣkaṃ khāded virekaṃ syāt sadyo hanti jalodaram // Rmañj_6.339 //
children.translated_text: one should eat one <s>niṣka</s> weight — it produces purgation and immediately destroys <s>jalodara</s> (ascites). // Rmañj_6.339 //

children.text: recanānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ dadhyannaṃ stambhanaṃ hitam /
children.translated_text: For all purgatives, rice with yogurt is the recommended food for arresting [the purging];

children.text: dinānte ca pradātavyamannaṃ vā mudgayūṣakam // Rmañj_6.340 //
children.translated_text: at the end of the day, food should be given, or <s>mudga</s> (mung bean) soup. // Rmañj_6.340 //
<s>Nārāca Rasa</s> (Iron-Arrow Preparation)
<s>Sūta</s> (mercury) and <s>ṭaṅkaṇa</s> (borax) in equal parts, <s>marica</s> (black pepper) equal to the mercury,

children.text: gandhakaṃ pippalī śuṇṭhī dvau dvau bhāgau vicūrṇayet // Rmañj_6.341 //
children.translated_text: <s>gandhaka</s> (sulfur), <s>pippalī</s> (long pepper), <s>śuṇṭhī</s> (dry ginger) — two parts each should be powdered. // Rmañj_6.341 //
Equal to all combined, one should add <s>dantī</s> (Baliospermum) seeds, dehusked;
two <s>guñjā</s> weight is effective as a purgative — this great <s>rasa</s> is <s>Nārāca</s> (Iron-Arrow);
it destroys <s>gulma</s> (abdominal tumors), <s>plīha</s> (splenic disorders), and <s>udara</s> (abdominal enlargement); one should drink it with warm water. // Rmañj_6.342 //
<s>Icchābhedī Rasa</s> (Purging-at-Will Preparation)
<s>Śuṇṭhī</s> (dry ginger) and <s>marica</s> (black pepper) combined with <s>rasa</s> (mercury), <s>gandhaka</s> (sulfur), and <s>ṭaṅkaṇa</s> (borax);
<s>jaipāla</s> (Croton) is prescribed as triple [the rest]; all should be powdered together. // Rmañj_6.343 //
<s>Icchābhedī</s> should be two <s>guñjā</s> weight, given with sugar;
one should drink, and as many sips as one takes, so many times it purges. // Rmañj_6.344 //
Buttermilk with rice should be given [as diet]; <s>Icchābhedī</s> [purges] as one wishes;
if the <s>doṣas</s> (humors) are ever aggravated, they are overcome by fasting and digestive treatments. // Rmañj_6.345 //
Rmañj, 7
Having bowed to Lord <s>Nirbhaya</s> (the Fearless), <s>Khendradeva</s>, the Lord of the world,
the sky-clad, three-eyed one, the destroyer of old age and death, // Rmañj_7.1 //

children.text: amṛtaṃ ca viṣaṃ caiva śivenoktaṃ rasāyanam /
children.translated_text: [that which is] nectar and [that which is] poison — <s>rasāyana</s> (rejuvenation) has been taught by <s>Śiva</s>;

children.text: amṛtaṃ vidhisaṃyuktaṃ vidhihīnaṃ tu tadviṣam // Rmañj_7.2 //
children.translated_text: when [administered] with proper method, it is nectar; without proper method, it becomes poison. // Rmañj_7.2 //
After purgation, this should be taken for the removal of all <s>doṣas</s> (humoral imbalances);
the wise one should first consume calcined <s>abhra</s> (mica) for one month. // Rmañj_7.3 //
Afterwards, one should apply [mercury] to the body, desiring <s>kṣetrīkaraṇa</s> (preparation of the bodily field);
for without <s>kṣetrīkaraṇa</s>, even mercury, though [potentially] nectar, becomes poison. // Rmañj_7.4 //
How can there be fruition of results for a good seed [sown] in barren soil?
O <s>Devī</s>, without field-preparation, one should not undertake any <s>rasāyana</s> (rejuvenation);
<s>kṣetrakaraṇa</s> (field-preparation) must be performed for every <s>rasāyana</s> treatment. // Rmañj_7.5 //
<s>Sūta</s> (mercury) <s>bhasma</s> (ash), double [quantity of] <s>gandha</s> (sulfur), ground briefly with <s>kanyā</s> (aloe) juice,

children.text: ruddhvā laghupuṭe pacyād uddhṛtya madhusarpiṣā // Rmañj_7.6 //
children.translated_text: sealed and cooked in a light <s>puṭa</s> (calcination), having extracted it, [take] with honey and ghee — // Rmañj_7.6 //
one should eat one <s>niṣka</s> weight; it destroys old age and death — this <s>rasa</s> is <s>Gandhāmṛta</s> (Sulfur-Nectar);

children.text: samūlaṃ bhṛṅgarājaṃ tu chāyāśuṣkaṃ vicūrṇayet // Rmañj_7.7 //
children.translated_text: <s>bhṛṅgarāja</s> (Eclipta) with its root, shade-dried, should be powdered; // Rmañj_7.7 //
an equal amount of <s>triphalā</s> (three fruits) powder, and sugar equal to all combined;
one should eat one <s>pala</s> as an adjuvant — that destroys death and disease. // Rmañj_7.8 //
One-quarter part of calcined <s>sūta</s> (mercury) should be apportioned as <s>hema</s> (gold) <s>bhasma</s> (ash); // Rmañj_7.9 //
milk and ghee mixed with honey, one <s>māṣa</s> weight in a bronze vessel —
one should lick [this] for six months; it destroys old age and death. // Rmañj_7.10 //
One <s>karṣa</s> of <s>vākucī</s> (Psoralea) powder, saturated with <s>dhātrī</s> (āmalaka/gooseberry) juice,
should be licked daily as an adjuvant; this <s>rasa</s> is <s>Hemasundara</s>. // Rmañj_7.11 //
<s>Mṛtasaṃjīvanī Guṭikā</s> (Pill that Revives the Dead)
Purified <s>sūta</s> (mercury), <s>vajra</s> (diamond) <s>bhasma</s> (ash), the essence of <s>abhraka</s> (mica) and <s>tāpya</s> (pyrite),

children.text: kāntalohasamaṃ hema jambīre mardayed dṛḍham // Rmañj_7.12 //
children.translated_text: <s>kāntaloha</s> (magnetic iron), equal [quantity of] <s>hema</s> (gold) — should be firmly ground in lemon [juice]. // Rmañj_7.12 //
For seven days, all in equal parts, having made a ball, one should extract it;
[then apply a paste of] <s>gojihvā</s> (Onosma), <s>vāyasī</s>, <s>vandhyā</s> (barren Karañja), <s>nirguṇḍī</s> (Vitex), honey, and <s>saindhava</s> (rock salt); // Rmañj_7.13 //
one should coat the inside of a diamond crucible and place the ball therein;

children.text: tatkalkaiśchāditaṃ kṛtvā pakṣaikaṃ bhūdhare pacet // Rmañj_7.14 //
children.translated_text: having covered it with those pastes, one should cook in an earthen furnace for one fortnight. // Rmañj_7.14 //

children.text: yāmaṃ yāmaṃ samuddhṛtya liptvāmūṣāṃ punaḥ punaḥ /
children.translated_text: Every <s>yāma</s> (three hours), having taken it out, one should coat the crucible again and again;
having sealed it again as before, one should cook it and extract after a fortnight. // Rmañj_7.15 //
With barley, tamarind, <s>palāśa</s> (Butea), <s>rājikā</s> (mustard), cotton, and rice —

children.text: etaiḥ pralepayenmūṣāṃ guṭikāṃ tatra nikṣipet // Rmañj_7.16 //
children.translated_text: with these one should coat the crucible and place the pill therein. // Rmañj_7.16 //

children.text: ṭaṅkaṇaṃ śvetakācaṃ ca dattvā yāme dṛḍhaṃ dṛḍham /
children.translated_text: Having added <s>ṭaṅkaṇa</s> (borax) and white glass, [blowing] firmly and firmly every <s>yāma</s>,
by means of <s>khadira</s> (Acacia) charcoal fire, this <s>rasa</s> becomes melted. // Rmañj_7.17 //

children.text: mūṣāyāṃ biḍayogena samaṃ hema ca jārayet /
children.translated_text: In a crucible, with a <s>biḍa</s> flux method, one should digest equal [quantity of] gold;
then it should be ground for three <s>yāmas</s> (nine hours) with cow's urine for one day. // Rmañj_7.18 //
Blown [with bellows] in a sealed crucible, it becomes bound like diamond;
this pill, named <s>Mṛtasaṃjīvanī</s> (Reviver of the Dead), resides in the middle of the body. // Rmañj_7.19 //

children.text: karṣamātrā jarāṃ mṛtyuṃ hanti satyaṃ śivoditam /
children.translated_text: In the dose of one <s>karṣa</s>, it destroys old age and death — truly, as declared by <s>Śiva</s>;

children.text: śastrastambhaṃ ca kurute brahmāyurbhavate naraḥ // Rmañj_7.20 //
children.translated_text: it produces invulnerability to weapons, and the person attains the lifespan of <s>Brahmā</s>. // Rmañj_7.20 //
<s>Vīryarodhinī Guṭikā</s> (Semen-Retaining Pill)
With the juice of <s>nāgavallī</s> (betel vine) leaves, purified <s>sūta</s> (mercury) for seven days
should be ground; it should be washed with sour [liquids], in the measure of four <s>niṣkas</s>. // Rmañj_7.21 //
Having placed it in [the tuber of] <s>viṣakanda</s> (poison bulb), one should seal it with the <s>viṣa</s> (poison) itself;

children.text: tataḥ śūkaramāṃsasya garbhe kṛtvātha siñcayet // Rmañj_7.22 //
children.translated_text: then, having placed it in the interior of pig's flesh, one should sprinkle [cook] it. // Rmañj_7.22 //
Having offered a <s>bali</s> (ritual offering) at twilight, combined with hen [flesh] and <s>vāruṇī</s> (liquor),
then in a furnace, in an iron vessel, in oil mixed with <s>dhattūra</s> (thorn apple), // Rmañj_7.23 //
having cast [the preparation] weighing thirty <s>palas</s>, one should cook that mercury-meat ball;

children.text: saṃdhyām ārabhya mandāgnau yāvatsūryodayaṃ pacet // Rmañj_7.24 //
children.translated_text: beginning at twilight, on a gentle fire, one should cook until sunrise. // Rmañj_7.24 //
One should forcibly maintain a vigil; otherwise one will not obtain <s>siddhi</s> (success).
In the morning, having extracted the pill, one should place it in a vessel of milk. // Rmañj_7.25 //
That milk dries up quickly — this is the proof of [its] efficacy.

children.text: ratikāle mukhe dhāryā guṭikā vīryarodhinī // Rmañj_7.26 //
children.translated_text: At the time of lovemaking, the pill that restrains <s>vīrya</s> (seminal fluid) should be held in the mouth. // Rmañj_7.26 //
Having drunk milk, one may enjoy a woman overwhelmed with desire and passion;
when one holds [the pill] from one's mouth in the hand, then the <s>vīrya</s> (seminal fluid) is released. // Rmañj_7.27 //
<s>Rasamañjarī</s>, Chapter 8
Now, for one whose <s>doṣas</s> (humors) are fully matured, one should perform the prescribed <s>añjana</s> (collyrium) application.
In <s>hemanta</s> (early winter) and <s>śiśira</s> (late winter), collyrium application at midday is recommended. // Rmañj_8.1 //

children.text: pūrvāhne cāparāhṇe ca grīṣme śaradi ceṣyate /
children.translated_text: In the forenoon and afternoon, it is recommended in summer and autumn;

children.text: varṣāsu kuryādatyuṣṇe vā vasante sadaiva hi // Rmañj_8.2 //
children.translated_text: in the rainy season, one should apply it when it is extremely hot, or in spring, always indeed. // Rmañj_8.2 //
When fatigued, when weeping, when frightened, when intoxicated, in fresh fever,

children.text: ajīrṇe vegaghāte ca añjanaṃ na praśasyate // Rmañj_8.3 //
children.translated_text: in indigestion, and when natural urges are suppressed — collyrium is not recommended. // Rmañj_8.3 //
The physician should make a wick the size of a grain of mustard for sharp collyrium;

children.text: pramāṇaṃ madhyamaṃ sārdhaṃ dviguṇaṃ ca mṛdau bhavet // Rmañj_8.4 //
children.translated_text: the medium measure should be one-and-a-half, and for mild [collyrium] it should be double. // Rmañj_8.4 //
<s>Sūtaka</s> (mercury compound), <s>gandhaka</s> (sulphur), lead, coagulated with the juice of <s>cāṅgerī</s> (sorrel) —
this collyrium bestows sight to men and destroys diseases of the eye. // Rmañj_8.5 //
<s>Rasendra</s> (mercury) and <s>bhujaga</s> (lead) in equal parts, with twice that amount of collyrium,
and camphor equal to one-fourth of the mercury — this collyrium is nectar for the eyes. // Rmañj_8.6 //
The fat of a black serpent, <s>śaṅkha</s> (conch shell), <s>kataka</s> (clearing nut), <s>kaṭphala</s> (Myrica) as collyrium —

children.text: rasa eva marīcena andhānāṃ darśanaṃ param // Rmañj_8.7 //
children.translated_text: mercury itself with <s>marīca</s> (black pepper) is the supreme sight-giver for the blind. // Rmañj_8.7 //
Four parts of conch shell, half of that [amount] of <s>manaḥśilā</s> (realgar),
half of the realgar [amount] of <s>marica</s> (black pepper), and half of the pepper [amount] of <s>pippalī</s> (long pepper); // Rmañj_8.8 //

children.text: vāriṇā timiraṃ hanti arbudaṃ hanti mastunā /
children.translated_text: with water it destroys <s>timira</s> (dimness of vision), with brain-marrow it destroys <s>arbuda</s> (tumor);

children.text: cipiṭaṃ madhunā hanti strīkṣīreṇa ca puṣpakam // Rmañj_8.9 //
children.translated_text: with honey it destroys <s>cipiṭa</s> (corneal opacity), and with woman's milk it [destroys] <s>puṣpa</s> (cataract). // Rmañj_8.9 //
Having ground the tip of <s>apāmārga</s> (Achyranthes aspera) with honey and rock salt,

children.text: tāmrapātre kṛtā netre hanti pīḍāṃ suvistarāt // Rmañj_8.10 //
children.translated_text: [and] prepared in a copper vessel, [when applied] to the eyes, it removes pain extensively. // Rmañj_8.10 //
With teeth from elephants, boars, camels, cows, horses, goats, and donkeys,
combined with conch shell, pearls, and sea-foam, all should be powdered.

children.text: hanti vartiḥ kṛtā ślakṣṇaṃ śukrāṇāṃ nāśinī param // Rmañj_8.11 //
children.translated_text: A wick prepared [from this] finely destroys <s>śukra</s> (corneal opacity) supremely. // Rmañj_8.11 //
<s>Tuttha</s> (copper sulphate), <s>mākṣika</s> (iron pyrite), <s>saindhava</s> (rock salt), <s>śivā</s> (Terminalia chebula), conch shell, <s>manaḥśilā</s> (realgar),

children.text: gairikodakaphenaṃ ca maricaṃ ceti cūrṇayet // Rmañj_8.12 //
children.translated_text: <s>gairika</s> (red ochre), water-foam, and <s>marica</s> (black pepper) — these should be powdered. // Rmañj_8.12 //
Combined with honey, one should prepare this <s>rasakriyā</s> (collyrium extract) for the blind;

children.text: vartmarogaṃ ca timiraṃ kācaśukraharaṃ param // Rmañj_8.13 //
children.translated_text: it supremely removes eyelid diseases, <s>timira</s> (dimness), <s>kāca</s> (glaucoma), and <s>śukra</s> (corneal opacity). // Rmañj_8.13 //
<s>Śaṅkhanābhi</s> (conch-shell operculum), the marrow of <s>vibhītaka</s> (Terminalia bellirica), <s>pathyā</s> (Terminalia chebula), <s>manaḥśilā</s> (realgar),

children.text: pippalī maricaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vacā ceti samāṃśakam // Rmañj_8.14 //
children.translated_text: <s>pippalī</s> (long pepper), <s>marica</s> (black pepper), <s>kuṣṭha</s> (costus), and <s>vacā</s> (sweet flag) — in equal parts. // Rmañj_8.14 //
Having ground with goat's milk and made into a wick of proper measurement,
one should grind [a piece] the size of a mustard seed with water and then apply as collyrium. // Rmañj_8.15 //

children.text: timiraṃ māṃsavṛddhiṃ ca kācaṃ paṭalam arbudam /
children.translated_text: <s>Timira</s> (dimness of vision), flesh-growth, <s>kāca</s> (glaucoma), <s>paṭala</s> (film), <s>arbuda</s> (tumor),

children.text: rājyandhaṃ vārṣikaṃ puṣpaṃ varticandrodayā jayet // Rmañj_8.16 //
children.translated_text: <s>rājyandha</s> (night blindness), chronic <s>puṣpa</s> (cataract) — the wick called <s>Candrodaya</s> conquers [them all]. // Rmañj_8.16 //

children.text: śuddhe nāge drute tulyaṃ śuddhasūtaṃ vinikṣipet /
children.translated_text: In purified and melted lead, one should cast an equal amount of purified mercury;
[add] black collyrium equal to both — all should be powdered together. // Rmañj_8.17 //
One should add camphor equal to one-tenth of this powder;
this <s>pratyañjana</s> (counter-collyrium), destroyer of eye diseases, is nectar for the eyes. // Rmañj_8.18 //

children.text: bhuktvā pāṇitalaṃ ghṛṣṭvā cakṣuṣor yadi dīyate /
children.translated_text: After eating, if one rubs the palm of the hand and [then applies it] to the eyes,

children.text: jātā rogāḥ praṇaśyanti na bhavanti kadācana // Rmañj_8.19 //
children.translated_text: diseases that have arisen are destroyed and never occur again. // Rmañj_8.19 //
By washing the eyes every morning with a decoction of <s>triphalā</s> (the three fruits),
that water dispels <s>timira</s> (dimness of vision) in a short time. // Rmañj_8.20 //

children.text: triphalā lauhacūrṇaṃ tu vāriṇā peṣayet samam /
children.translated_text: <s>Triphalā</s> and iron powder should be ground equally with water;
with oil equal to both, one should cook on a gentle fire for a moment. // Rmañj_8.21 //
In <s>bhṛṅgarāja</s> (Eclipta alba) juice equal to the oil, one should further cook that oil;
stored in a greased vessel underground, after one month it should be taken out. // Rmañj_8.22 //
For seven days, one should apply [it] wrapping the head with banana leaves;

children.text: nirvāte kṣīrabhojī syāt chālayet triphalājalaiḥ // Rmañj_8.23 //
children.translated_text: in a wind-free place, one should consume only milk and rinse with <s>triphalā</s> water. // Rmañj_8.23 //
This should be done regularly — in seven days the hair becomes dyed;

children.text: yāvajjīvaṃ na sandehaḥ kacāḥ syurbhramaropamāḥ // Rmañj_8.24 //
children.translated_text: for life there is no doubt — the hair will be like bees [i.e., black as bees]. // Rmañj_8.24 //

children.text: kākamācī yavā jātī samaṃ kṛṣṇatilaṃ tataḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Kākamācī</s> (Solanum nigrum), barley, jasmine, equal [portions of] black sesame — then

children.text: tattailaṃ grāhayedyantre tena syāt keśarañjanam // Rmañj_8.25 //
children.translated_text: that oil should be extracted by a device; with it, hair-dyeing is achieved. // Rmañj_8.25 //
A person who always bathes with a paste of iron rust and pure iron-filings mixed with <s>japā</s> (hibiscus) flowers
destroys grey hairs here, just as one who bathes in the <s>Gaṅgā</s> destroys heaps of sins. // Rmañj_8.26 //

children.text: kāśmaryā mūlamādau sahacarakusumaṃ ketakīnāṃ ca mūlaṃ lauhaṃ cūrṇaṃ sabhṛṅgaṃ triphalajalayutaṃ tailamebhir vipakvam /
children.translated_text: The root of <s>kāśmarya</s> (Gmelina arborea) first, <s>sahacara</s> (Barleria) flowers, the root of <s>ketakī</s> (Pandanus), iron powder with <s>bhṛṅga</s> (Eclipta), oil cooked with <s>triphalā</s> water —

children.text: kṛtvā vai lohabhāṇḍe kṣititalanihitaṃ māsam ekaṃ nidhāya keśāḥ kāśaprakāśā bhramarakulanibhā lepanād eva kṛṣṇāḥ // Rmañj_8.27 //
children.translated_text: having prepared [this] in an iron vessel and placed it underground for one month, hair [that was] pale as <s>kāśa</s> grass becomes black like a swarm of bees merely by application. // Rmañj_8.27 //
One should soak very white sesame seeds for seven days in the milk of <s>vajrī</s> (Euphorbia);

children.text: tailena liptāḥ keśāḥ syuḥ śuklā vai nātra saṃśayaḥ // Rmañj_8.28 //
children.translated_text: hair anointed with [its] oil will become white — there is no doubt indeed. // Rmañj_8.28 //
<s>Rasamañjarī</s>, Chapter 9

children.text: karpūraṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ sūtaṃ tulyaṃ munirasaṃ madhu /
children.translated_text: <s>Karpūra</s> (camphor), <s>ṭaṅkaṇa</s> (borax), mercury in equal parts, <s>munirasā</s> (agastya juice), and honey —

children.text: mardayitvā lipelliṅgaṃ sthitvā yāmaṃ tathaiva ca // Rmañj_9.1 //
children.translated_text: having ground [them], one should apply to the <s>liṅga</s> (penis), and remain thus for one <s>yāma</s> (three hours). // Rmañj_9.1 //
Then one should wash the <s>liṅga</s> and enjoy a suitable woman;
this produces seminal retention in men, as properly stated by <s>Nāgārjuna</s>. // Rmañj_9.2 //
The tip of the tail of a <s>kṛkalāsa</s> (lizard), [placed in] a ring strung with threads,

children.text: veṣṭyā kaniṣṭhikā dhāryā naro vīryaṃ na muñcati // Rmañj_9.3 //
children.translated_text: should be worn wrapped on the little finger — the man does not release <s>vīrya</s> (semen). // Rmañj_9.3 //
Having ground lotus seeds with honey, one should apply [it] to the navel;
as long as that paste remains, so long one does not release <s>vīrya</s> (semen). // Rmañj_9.4 //
Having collected a sparrow's egg, one should grind it with fresh butter;
with that one should anoint the feet — <s>śukrastambha</s> (seminal retention) is produced.

children.text: yāvanna spṛśate bhūmiṃ tāvadvīryaṃ na muñcati // Rmañj_9.5 //
children.translated_text: As long as [the feet] do not touch the ground, so long one does not release <s>vīrya</s> (semen). // Rmañj_9.5 //
One should collect the right tusk-tip of a wild boar;

children.text: kaṭyāmupari yad baddhvā śukrastambhaḥ prajāyate // Rmañj_9.6 //
children.translated_text: having tied it above the waist, <s>śukrastambha</s> (seminal retention) is produced. // Rmañj_9.6 //

body.translated_text: There is a serpent named <s>ḍuṇḍubha</s>, black in color — one should collect it. // Rmañj_9.7 //

children.text: tasyāsthi dhārayet kaṭyāṃ naro vīryaṃ na muñcati /
children.translated_text: One who wears its bone on the waist — that man does not release <s>vīrya</s> (semen);
when released by the released [bone being removed], the accomplished formula is declared. // Rmañj_9.8 //
The root of red <s>apāmārga</s> (Achyranthes), consecrated with mantras on a Monday,

children.text: bhaume prātaḥ samuddhṛtya kaṭyāṃ baddhvā na vīryamuk // Rmañj_9.9 //
children.translated_text: extracted in the morning on a Tuesday and tied to the waist — one does not release <s>vīrya</s> (semen). // Rmañj_9.9 //

children.text: khasapalaṃ śuṇṭhīkvāthaḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśena guḍena niśi pītaḥ /
children.translated_text: One <s>pala</s> of <s>śuṇṭhī</s> (dry ginger) decoction, with one-sixteenth part <s>guḍa</s> (jaggery), drunk at night,

children.text: kurute ratau na puṃso retaḥ patanaṃ vināmlena // Rmañj_9.10 //
children.translated_text: prevents the fall of semen in a man during intercourse, without acidity. // Rmañj_9.10 //
One should eat <s>sūraṇa</s> (elephant yam) and <s>tulasī</s> (holy basil) root with betel;

children.text: na muñcati naro vīryamekaikena na saṃśayaḥ // Rmañj_9.11 //
children.translated_text: a man does not release <s>vīrya</s> (semen) by each one [separately] — there is no doubt. // Rmañj_9.11 //
One should apply boar's fat with honey to the <s>liṅga</s> (penis);

children.text: sthūlaṃ dṛḍhaṃ ca dīrghaṃ ca puṃso liṅgaṃ prajāyate // Rmañj_9.12 //
children.translated_text: the man's <s>liṅga</s> becomes thick, firm, and long. // Rmañj_9.12 //

children.text: kṣaudreṇa ca samaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ puṇḍarīkasya keśaram /
children.translated_text: The stamens of <s>puṇḍarīka</s> (white lotus), ground equally with honey,
[applied to] the <s>meḍhra</s> (penis), it becomes erect — also for pleasure elsewhere, without doubt. // Rmañj_9.13 //
Under the <s>Anurādhā</s> constellation, the root of <s>lāṅgalī</s> (Gloriosa superba) certainly,
if buried at the place of intercourse, destroys a man's virility. // Rmañj_9.14 //
<s>Niśā</s> (turmeric) with <s>tindu</s> (Diospyros) powder, treated with goat's urine —

children.text: pānāśanaṃ prayuktena ṣaṇḍhatvaṃ jāyate nṛṇām // Rmañj_9.15 //
children.translated_text: when administered in food and drink, impotence is produced in men. // Rmañj_9.15 //
Powder of sesame and <s>gokṣura</s> (Tribulus terrestris), cooked in goat's milk,

children.text: śītalaṃ madhunā yuktaṃ bhuktaṃ ṣaṇḍhatvanāśanam // Rmañj_9.16 //
children.translated_text: when cooled and mixed with honey and consumed, it destroys impotence. // Rmañj_9.16 //

children.text: ūrṇanābhistu yo jīvo madhunā saha lepayet /
children.translated_text: The creature that is a spider — one should [take it] with honey and apply;

children.text: tena lepayato nābhiṃ baddhaṣaṇḍhyaṃ vimucyate // Rmañj_9.17 //
children.translated_text: by applying that to the navel, bound impotence is released. // Rmañj_9.17 //
The juice born of <s>mālatī</s> (jasmine) alone is a great aphrodisiac;
how much more so if combined with honey, camphor, and mercury! // Rmañj_9.18 //

children.text: ārdrakaṃ gandhakaṃ caiva rājikaṃ cātha ṭaṅkaṇam /
children.translated_text: Fresh ginger, <s>gandhaka</s> (sulphur), mustard seeds, and <s>ṭaṅkaṇa</s> (borax) —
ground in equal measures, one should cast [them] into <s>nimbuja</s> (lemon) water. // Rmañj_9.19 //
One should let it stand for three <s>ghaṭikās</s> (72 minutes), or hold it in the hand; then

children.text: yāvantyo lalanāḥ pañca ājighranti dravanti vai // Rmañj_9.20 //
children.translated_text: as many as five women who smell it will become aroused indeed. // Rmañj_9.20 //
Powdered and mixed with honey, with <s>mahāriṣṭa</s> (Sapindus) fruit bark —

children.text: liṅgalepena surate dravo bhavati yoṣitām // Rmañj_9.21 //
children.translated_text: by applying [this] to the <s>liṅga</s> during intercourse, arousal is produced in women. // Rmañj_9.21 //
Mixed with honey and rock salt, combined with pigeon droppings —

children.text: etalliptendriyo rāmāṃ dāsīvat kurute ratau // Rmañj_9.22 //
children.translated_text: one who anoints the organ with this makes a woman a slave in lovemaking. // Rmañj_9.22 //

children.text: kapīndriyaṃ śaśī sūtaṃ kuṅkumaṃ kanakaṃ madhu /
children.translated_text: The organ of a monkey, camphor, mercury, <s>kuṅkuma</s> (saffron), gold, and honey —

children.text: etalliptendriyo rāmāṃ dāsīvat kurute ratau // Rmañj_9.23 //
children.translated_text: one who anoints the organ with this makes a woman a slave in lovemaking. // Rmañj_9.23 //
The name [of the desired one] placed at the center of a circle, outside it four <s>hrīṃ</s> [syllables],

children.text: tadbahiḥ klīṃ catuṣkaṃ ca likhitvā śilayākhilam // Rmañj_9.24 //
children.translated_text: outside that four <s>klīṃ</s> [syllables] — having written all this on stone, // Rmañj_9.24 //
placed in honey during an auspicious constellation — it certainly

children.text: striyam ākarṣati kṣipraṃ yantrametanna saṃśayaḥ // Rmañj_9.25 //
children.translated_text: attracts a woman quickly — this <s>yantra</s> (diagram), there is no doubt. // Rmañj_9.25 //
<s>Candana</s> (sandalwood), <s>tagara</s> (valerian), <s>kuṣṭha</s> (costus), <s>priyaṅgu</s> (Callicarpa), <s>nāgakeśara</s> (Mesua ferrea),

children.text: kṛṣṇāṃ tintiḍikaṃ caiva samabhāgāni kārayet // Rmañj_9.26 //
children.translated_text: <s>kṛṣṇā</s> (long pepper), and <s>tintiḍika</s> (tamarind) — one should prepare these in equal parts. // Rmañj_9.26 //
One should soak [them] for seven days in one's own five bodily excretions;

children.text: khāne pāne pradātavyaṃ striyaṃ vā puruṣaṃ tathā // Rmañj_9.27 //
children.translated_text: it should be administered in food or drink, to a woman or a man. // Rmañj_9.27 //
<s>Śaṃkhapuṣpī</s> (Convolvulus), <s>madhupuṣpī</s> (Madhuca flower), and <s>kuñcikipatrikā</s>,
combined with white chalk — one should prepare these in equal parts. // Rmañj_9.28 //
Soaked for seven days combined with one's own five bodily excretions,
it should be administered in food or drink — this is the supreme <s>vaśīkaraṇa</s> (subjugation formula). // Rmañj_9.29 //
With the previously stated <s>mantra</s>, having consecrated it seven times, one should administer it.
Having taken the dust from a donkey, the rolling-dust born of its body,
and likewise the ash of a corpse, combined with a woman's menstrual discharge, // Rmañj_9.30 //
having combined them and scattered at night on the bed or seat —

children.text: nūnaṃ saṃjāyate dveṣaḥ kathito mālatīmate // Rmañj_9.31 //
children.translated_text: hatred is certainly produced — this is declared in the <s>Mālatīmata</s> [text]. // Rmañj_9.31 //
I shall declare another excellent formula that produces enmity:
two dogs fighting, mutually hostile — // Rmañj_9.32 //

children.text: tayor dhūliṃ samādāya hanyate yoṣitāṃ ratiḥ /
children.translated_text: having collected the dust from [between] them, it destroys the love of women;

children.text: satyaṃ bhavati vidveṣaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā // Rmañj_9.33 //
children.translated_text: truly enmity is produced — here no deliberation should be made. // Rmañj_9.33 //
By regularly washing the <s>bhaga</s> (female genitalia) with the bark of <s>āmalaka</s> (Indian gooseberry),

children.text: vṛddhāpi kāminī kāmaṃ bāleva kurute ratim // Rmañj_9.34 //
children.translated_text: even an aged woman performs lovemaking with desire like a young girl. // Rmañj_9.34 //
Lotus seeds with sugar, consumed with lotus water —

children.text: dṛḍhaṃ strīṇāṃ stanadvandvaṃ māsena kurute bhṛśam // Rmañj_9.35 //
children.translated_text: within a month, it makes a woman's pair of breasts very firm. // Rmañj_9.35 //
Oil cooked with the powder and decoction of <s>muṇḍī</s> (Sphaeranthus) —
a woman whose youth has declined — her breasts will become elevated. // Rmañj_9.36 //
By application of a paste made from <s>haritāla</s> (orpiment) powder with its own water, immediately

children.text: nipatanti keśanicayāḥ kautukamidam adbhutaṃ kurute // Rmañj_9.37 //
children.translated_text: masses of hair fall off — this creates a curious and wonderful [effect]. // Rmañj_9.37 //
<s>Palāśa</s> (Butea monosperma), tamarind, sesame, black gram, conch shell — one should burn [these], and also <s>apāmārga</s> (Achyranthes) with <s>pippalī</s> (long pepper);
by application of paste made from <s>manaḥśilā</s> (realgar) and <s>tālaka</s> (orpiment) powder, it makes the head hairless in an instant. // Rmañj_9.38 //
Having ground the roots of <s>taṇḍulīyaka</s> (Amaranthus) with rice-wash water,

children.text: ṛtvante tryahapītāni vandhyāṃ kurvanti yoṣitam // Rmañj_9.39 //
children.translated_text: drunk for three days at the end of the menstrual period, they make a woman barren. // Rmañj_9.39 //
The woman who grinds <s>japā</s> (hibiscus) flower with <s>kāñjika</s> (fermented rice water) and drinks it,

children.text: ṛtau tryahaṃ nipītāni vandhyāṃ kurvanti yoṣitam // Rmañj_9.40 //
children.translated_text: having drunk it for three days during the menstrual period — it makes the woman barren. // Rmañj_9.40 //
When the vaginal passage is fumigated with <s>nimba</s> (neem) wood skillfully,

children.text: ṛtvante ramate sā strī garbhaduḥkhavivarjitā // Rmañj_9.41 //
children.translated_text: at the end of the menstrual period, that woman enjoys intercourse free from the suffering of pregnancy. // Rmañj_9.41 //
Taking <s>dhattūra</s> (Datura) and <s>mallikā</s> (jasmine) flower, placed at the waist,
it indeed prevents pregnancy in widows, courtesans, and other such women. // Rmañj_9.42 //
The powder of <s>nāgakeśara</s> (Mesua ferrea) flowers together with cow's ghee —
by consuming it during the menstrual period, a woman who eats milk and rice obtains a son. // Rmañj_9.43 //
The seeds of <s>mātuluṅga</s> (citron), steamed with milk and with ghee,
by drinking, they make even a barren woman become pregnant. // Rmañj_9.44 //
One should grind the seeds of <s>mātuluṅga</s> (citron) together with <s>kumārī</s> (aloe vera);
it should be given with milk — she obtains pregnancy without doubt. // Rmañj_9.45 //

children.text: pippalī śṛṅgaveraṃ ca maricaṃ keśaraṃ tathā /
children.translated_text: <s>Pippalī</s> (long pepper), <s>śṛṅgavera</s> (dry ginger), <s>marica</s> (black pepper), and <s>keśara</s> (saffron) —

children.text: ghṛtena saha pātavyaṃ vandhyāgarbhapradaṃ param // Rmañj_9.46 //
children.translated_text: these should be drunk with ghee; it is the supreme bestower of pregnancy upon a barren woman. // Rmañj_9.46 //

children.text: puṣyoddhṛtaṃ lakṣmaṇāyā mūlaṃ piṣṭaṃ ca kanyakā /
children.translated_text: A young girl, having ground the root of <s>Lakṣmaṇā</s> extracted during <s>Puṣya</s> nakṣatra,
and having drunk it with ghee and milk at the end of the menstrual period, she may obtain pregnancy. // Rmañj_9.47 //

children.text: anyad yogavaraṃ vakṣye yena sā saphalā bhavet /
children.translated_text: I shall describe another excellent formulation by which she shall become fruitful:
<s>uśīra</s> (vetiver), <s>madhuyaṣṭī</s> (licorice), <s>lodhra</s> (Symplocos), and <s>indrayava</s> (Holarrhena seeds), // Rmañj_9.48 //
ghee, <s>sarjarasa</s> (sal resin), honey, and <s>trāyamāṇa</s> (Gentiana),
roots of <s>śobhāñjana</s> (Moringa) — one should prepare all in equal parts. // Rmañj_9.49 //
Having ground the ingredients, one should then cook them with goat's milk;
the woman should drink it for seven nights, as long as the menstrual bleeding lasts. // Rmañj_9.50 //
Then, when the vagina is purified, afterwards one should give the great medicine
combined with the juice of <s>kumārī</s> (aloe vera), administered as nasal drops and as a drink. // Rmañj_9.51 //

children.text: tena sā labhate putraṃ satyaṃ caiva surārcitam /
children.translated_text: By that, she obtains a son — truly one honored by the gods.

children.text: laśunaṃ kṣīrasaṃyuktaṃ nasye pāne pradāpayet // Rmañj_9.52 //
children.translated_text: <s>Laśuna</s> (garlic) combined with milk should be administered as nasal drops and as a drink. // Rmañj_9.52 //
Powder made from <s>aśvagandhā</s> (Withania somnifera) should be given with goat's milk.

children.text: yavakṣāraṃ viḍaṅgaṃ ca guḍūcī ca hareṇukā // Rmañj_9.53 //
children.translated_text: <s>Yavakṣāra</s> (barley alkali), <s>viḍaṅga</s> (Embelia ribes), <s>guḍūcī</s> (Tinospora), and <s>hareṇukā</s> (Vitex negundo seeds), // Rmañj_9.53 //
having made all in equal parts and prepared them as excellent powder —

children.text: etatpītvā labhet putraṃ sā nārī nātra saṃśayaḥ // Rmañj_9.54 //
children.translated_text: having drunk this, that woman obtains a son; there is no doubt in this. // Rmañj_9.54 //

children.text: hiṅguṃ ca śatavīryā ca dāḍimaṃ saindhavaṃ tathā /
children.translated_text: <s>Hiṅgu</s> (asafoetida), <s>śatavīryā</s>, <s>dāḍima</s> (pomegranate), <s>saindhava</s> (rock salt),

children.text: trikaṭuḥ śatapuṣpā ca nāgapuṣpaṃ śatāvarī // Rmañj_9.55 //
children.translated_text: <s>trikaṭu</s> (three pungents), <s>śatapuṣpā</s> (dill), <s>nāgapuṣpa</s> (Mesua flower), <s>śatāvarī</s> (Asparagus racemosus), // Rmañj_9.55 //
<s>madhuka</s> (licorice), and <s>sumanā</s> (jasmine) — one should give each in the measure of one <s>kārṣa</s> (a unit of weight);

children.text: kṣīreṇa saha dātavyā nāryāśca puruṣasya ca // Rmañj_9.56 //
children.translated_text: they should be given with milk, to both the woman and the man. // Rmañj_9.56 //
For three days one should eat <s>śāli</s> rice with milk;

children.text: bhuktaṃ tu labhate garbhaṃ nārīṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ // Rmañj_9.57 //
children.translated_text: having eaten thus, the woman obtains pregnancy — there is no doubt in this. // Rmañj_9.57 //
<s>Arkamūla</s> (Calotropis root), <s>priyaṅgu</s> (Callicarpa), <s>kusumbha</s> (safflower), <s>nāgakeśara</s> (Mesua ferrea),

children.text: balā cātibalā chāgīkṣīraṃ pītaṃ dinatrayam // Rmañj_9.58 //
children.translated_text: <s>balā</s> (Sida cordifolia) and <s>atibalā</s> (Abutilon indicum) — goat's milk drunk for three days, // Rmañj_9.58 //
they purify the uterus; then one should give the great medicine:

children.text: utpalaṃ tagaraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu sacandanam // Rmañj_9.59 //
children.translated_text: <s>utpala</s> (blue lotus), <s>tagara</s> (Valeriana), <s>kuṣṭha</s> (Saussurea), <s>yaṣṭīmadhu</s> (licorice), with <s>candana</s> (sandalwood), // Rmañj_9.59 //
ground with goat's milk, one should administer for five days.
<s>Lakṣmaṇā</s> combined with cow's milk — one should administer it to her as a drink. // Rmañj_9.60 //

children.text: tena sā labhate putraṃ lakṣaṇāḍhyaṃ supaṇḍitam /
children.translated_text: By that she obtains a son, endowed with auspicious marks and greatly learned.

children.text: gate rakte bhage śuddhe sakṣīrā lakṣmaṇā tathā // Rmañj_9.61 //
children.translated_text: When the blood has passed and the womb is pure, <s>Lakṣmaṇā</s> with milk, // Rmañj_9.61 //
should be given as nasal drops and as a drink — the woman obtains a son.
White <s>arka</s> (Calotropis), <s>kṣudraṇī</s>, white <s>girikarṇikā</s>, // Rmañj_9.62 //
<s>Lakṣmaṇā</s>, <s>vandhyakarkoṭī</s> (Momordica) — these should be given combined with cow's milk,

children.text: nasye pāne kṛte garbhaṃ labhate ratisaṃgamāt // Rmañj_9.63 //
children.translated_text: administered as nasal drops and drink — she obtains pregnancy from sexual union. // Rmañj_9.63 //
One should arrest a falling (threatening miscarriage) pregnancy: potter's clay,
drunk with honey and goat's milk, or white <s>adrikarṇikā</s>. // Rmañj_9.64 //
<s>Lalanā</s>, sugar, <s>pāṭhā</s> (Cissampelos pareira), and the bulb mixed with honey —
when eaten, it indeed arrests the falling fetus in its place. // Rmañj_9.65 //
Equal parts of sugar and <s>śāli</s> rice powder,
drunk in a decoction of <s>udumbara</s> (fig tree) roots — it well protects the pregnancy. // Rmañj_9.66 //
The roots of <s>mātuluṅga</s> (citron) and <s>madhuka</s> (licorice) with honey,

children.text: ghṛtena saha pātavyaṃ sukhaṃ nārī prasūyate // Rmañj_9.67 //
children.translated_text: should be drunk with ghee — the woman delivers with ease. // Rmañj_9.67 //
One should anoint the feet with the tuber rubbed in husk-water
of <s>lāṅgalī</s> (Gloriosa superba) — the pregnant woman quickly obtains delivery. // Rmañj_9.68 //

children.text: yāsāṃ puṣpāgamo nāsti ṛtukāle ca yoṣitām /
children.translated_text: For those women in whom the menstrual flow does not come at the proper time,

children.text: tāsāṃ kuryāccikitseyaṃ punaḥ puṣpāgamo bhavet // Rmañj_9.69 //
children.translated_text: for them one should perform this treatment so that the menstrual flow returns. // Rmañj_9.69 //
<s>Pippalī</s> (long pepper), <s>yavakṣāra</s> (barley alkali), <s>viḍaṅga</s> (Embelia ribes), <s>manmathaphala</s>,

children.text: tiktaṃ tu tumbinībījaṃ guṭikāṃ kārayedbhiṣak // Rmañj_9.70 //
children.translated_text: and the bitter seeds of <s>tumbinī</s> (bottle gourd) — the physician should form pills. // Rmañj_9.70 //
<s>Muṇḍī</s> (Sphaeranthus) combined with milk, applied at the vaginal opening — the auspicious woman,
within three, five, or seven nights, the menstrual flow occurs, not otherwise. // Rmañj_9.71 //
I shall now describe the <s>bālatantra</s> (pediatric science) as taught by <s>Rāvaṇa</s>, in brief —

children.text: pūjādravyaṃ diśo bhāgaṃ mantraṃ tadgrāhyalakṣaṇam // Rmañj_9.72 //
children.translated_text: the items of worship, the directional portions, the <s>mantras</s>, and the characteristics of seizure by those [<s>yoginīs</s>]. // Rmañj_9.72 //

children.text: prathame divase māse varṣe gṛhṇāti bālakam /
children.translated_text: On the first day, month, or year, [the <s>yoginī</s>] seizes the child;

children.text: mandānāmnī samākhyātā yogiṇī tasya lakṣaṇam // Rmañj_9.73 //
children.translated_text: she is called <s>Mandā</s> by name — such is the characteristic of that <s>yoginī</s>. // Rmañj_9.73 //

children.text: dvitīye divase māse varṣe gṛhṇāti bālakam /
children.translated_text: On the second day, month, or year, [the <s>yoginī</s>] seizes the child;

children.text: sunandā yoginī nāma prathamaṃ jāyate jvaraḥ // Rmañj_9.74 //
children.translated_text: the <s>yoginī</s> named <s>Sunandā</s> — first fever arises. // Rmañj_9.74 //
Contraction of hands and feet, eye disease, excessive vomiting,

children.text: sabhayatvaṃ kṛśatvaṃ ca tadgrasta iti lakṣaṇam // Rmañj_9.75 //
children.translated_text: fearfulness and emaciation — these are the signs of seizure by her. // Rmañj_9.75 //

children.text: tṛtīye divase māse varṣe gṛhṇāti bālakam /
children.translated_text: On the third day, month, or year, [the <s>yoginī</s>] seizes the child;

children.text: pūtanā yoginī nāma gātrabhaṅgo jvaro'ruciḥ // Rmañj_9.76 //
children.translated_text: the <s>yoginī</s> named <s>Pūtanā</s> — body-ache, fever, and loss of appetite, // Rmañj_9.76 //
delirium, neck swelling, vomiting, and such are the signs.

children.text: aparāhne ca vāruṇyāṃ pañcarātraṃ baliṃ kṣipet // Rmañj_9.77 //
children.translated_text: In the afternoon, in the western direction, one should offer <s>bali</s> (oblation) for five nights. // Rmañj_9.77 //

children.text: caturthe divase māse varṣe gṛhṇāti bālakam /
children.translated_text: On the fourth day, month, or year, [the <s>yoginī</s>] seizes the child;

children.text: biḍālī nāma tadgraste cakṣuḥśūlaṃ jvaro'ruciḥ // Rmañj_9.78 //
children.translated_text: she is named <s>Biḍālī</s> — in one seized by her: eye-pain, fever, and loss of appetite, // Rmañj_9.78 //
body stiffness, and so forth — one should offer <s>bali</s> with multicolored [offerings].

children.text: pañcame divase māse varṣe gṛhṇāti bālakam // Rmañj_9.79 //
children.translated_text: On the fifth day, month, or year, [the <s>yoginī</s>] seizes the child; // Rmañj_9.79 //
she is called <s>Nartakī</s> — such is the characteristic of that <s>yoginī</s>.

children.text: atha ṣaṣṭhadine māse varṣe gṛhṇāti bālakam // Rmañj_9.80 //
children.translated_text: On the sixth day, month, or year, [the <s>yoginī</s>] seizes the child; // Rmañj_9.80 //
the <s>yoginī</s> named <s>Śakunī</s> — cough, dyspnea, loss of appetite, and fever,
contraction of hands and feet, and eye-affliction — these are the signs. // Rmañj_9.81 //

children.text: pañcarātraṃ baliṃ tasyai vāruṇyāṃ diśi nikṣipet /
children.translated_text: One should offer <s>bali</s> to her in the western direction for five nights.

children.text: saptame divase māse varṣe śuṣkāśivā śiśum // Rmañj_9.82 //
children.translated_text: On the seventh day, month, or year, <s>Śuṣkāśivā</s> [seizes] the child; // Rmañj_9.82 //
[she] seizes — weeping, trembling, fever, and wasting are the signs.

children.text: paścimāyāṃ diśi pañca balau datte śiśuḥ sukhī // Rmañj_9.83 //
children.translated_text: In the western direction, having given <s>bali</s> for five [nights], the child becomes well. // Rmañj_9.83 //

children.text: aṣṭame divase māse varṣe gṛhṇāti jṛmbhakā /
children.translated_text: On the eighth day, month, or year, <s>Jṛmbhakā</s> seizes [the child];

children.text: tayā gṛhītamātrasya prathamaṃ jāyate jvaraḥ // Rmañj_9.84 //
children.translated_text: upon being seized by her, first fever arises, // Rmañj_9.84 //
headache, eye disease, and movements as if tearing the eyes out.

children.text: dakṣiṇāṃ diśim āśritya baliṃ tasyai pradāpayet // Rmañj_9.85 //
children.translated_text: One should offer <s>bali</s> to her, resorting to the southern direction. // Rmañj_9.85 //

children.text: navame divase māse varṣe gṛhṇāti bālakam /
children.translated_text: On the ninth day, month, or year, [the <s>yoginī</s>] seizes the child;

children.text: acintā yoginī nāma gātrabhaṅgaḥ śiro'kṣiruk // Rmañj_9.86 //
children.translated_text: the <s>yoginī</s> named <s>Acintā</s> — body-ache, headache, and eye-pain, // Rmañj_9.86 //
vomiting, delirium, and so forth — these are the signs of seizure by her.

children.text: uttarāṃ diśim āśritya baliṃ tasyai pradāpayet // Rmañj_9.87 //
children.translated_text: One should offer <s>bali</s> to her, resorting to the northern direction. // Rmañj_9.87 //

children.text: daśame divase māse varṣe gṛhṇāti bālakam /
children.translated_text: On the tenth day, month, or year, [the <s>yoginī</s>] seizes the child;

children.text: nāmnā kāpālikā khyātā yoginī tasya lakṣaṇam // Rmañj_9.88 //
children.translated_text: the <s>yoginī</s> known by the name <s>Kāpālikā</s> — such are the signs: // Rmañj_9.88 //
weeping, trembling, vomiting, fever, weakness, and eye-pain.

children.text: pūrvāṃ diśaṃ samāśritya pañcarātraṃ baliṃ kṣipet // Rmañj_9.89 //
children.translated_text: One should offer <s>bali</s> for five nights, resorting to the eastern direction. // Rmañj_9.89 //

children.text: ekādaśe dine māse varṣe gṛhṇāti lipsitā /
children.translated_text: On the eleventh day, month, or year, <s>Lipsitā</s> seizes [the child];
body-trembling and intense fever — these are the signs of seizure by her. // Rmañj_9.90 //

children.text: bhānusaṃkhye dine māse varṣe gṛhṇāti bālakam /
children.translated_text: On the twelfth day, month, or year, [the <s>yoginī</s>] seizes the child;

children.text: pītalī yoginī nāma rodanaṃ vedanā jvaraḥ // Rmañj_9.91 //
children.translated_text: the <s>yoginī</s> named <s>Pītalī</s> — weeping, pain, and fever, // Rmañj_9.91 //
drowsiness, weakened voice, yellowness [of body], vomiting, and loss of appetite.

children.text: uttarāṃ diśimāśritya saptarātraṃ baliṃ kṣipet // Rmañj_9.92 //
children.translated_text: One should offer <s>bali</s> for seven nights, resorting to the northern direction. // Rmañj_9.92 //

children.text: kāmasaṃkhye dine māse varṣe gṛhṇati bālakam /
children.translated_text: On the thirteenth day, month, or year, [the <s>yoginī</s>] seizes the child;

children.text: bhadrakālī jvaro nāma vāmahastasya kampam // Rmañj_9.93 //
children.translated_text: <s>Bhadrakālī</s> — fever by name, trembling of the left hand, // Rmañj_9.93 //
pain, loss of appetite, breathlessness, yellowness of the body, and restless movements.

children.text: pūrvāṃ diśaḥ samāśritya baliṃ tasyai pradāpayet // Rmañj_9.94 //
children.translated_text: One should offer <s>bali</s> to her, resorting to the eastern direction. // Rmañj_9.94 //
On the fourteenth day, month, or year, [the <s>yoginī</s>] seizes the child;

children.text: tārā hi yoginī nāma jvaraḥ śoṣo'rucirbhṛśam // Rmañj_9.95 //
children.translated_text: the <s>yoginī</s> named <s>Tārā</s> — fever, wasting, and severe loss of appetite, // Rmañj_9.95 //
eye-affliction and restless movements — one should bring <s>bali</s> to her in the western [direction].

children.text: pakṣe ca divase māse varṣe gṛhṇāti bālakam // Rmañj_9.96 //
children.translated_text: On the fifteenth day, month, or year, [the <s>yoginī</s>] seizes the child; // Rmañj_9.96 //
the <s>yoginī</s> named <s>Śarvarī</s> — dyspnea, cough, loss of appetite, and fever,

children.text: tadgraste cihnam ityādi dakṣiṇasyāṃ baliṃ kṣipet // Rmañj_9.97 //
children.translated_text: these are the signs of seizure, and so forth — one should offer <s>bali</s> in the southern [direction]. // Rmañj_9.97 //
On the sixteenth day, month, or year, the <s>yoginī</s> seizes [the child];
[she is called] <s>Kumārī</s> — disturbance of the eyes, fever, wasting, and such movements, // Rmañj_9.98 //
one should offer <s>bali</s> for seven nights, resorting to the southwestern direction.
And then one should bathe the child with sanctified water, [performed by] one who knows the <s>mantras</s>. // Rmañj_9.99 //
Having made a figure of the goddess from clay gathered from both banks of a river,

children.text: kṛtvā pūjā ca kartavyā bhūpapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ // Rmañj_9.100 //
children.translated_text: worship should be performed with flowers, unbroken rice (<s>akṣata</s>), and other offerings. // Rmañj_9.100 //
<s>Vaṭaka</s> (fried balls), <s>laḍḍuka</s> (sweets), <s>āpūpa</s> (cakes), the first portion of cooked food, <s>guḍa</s> (jaggery), <s>dadhi</s> (yogurt),
flags of four colors, lit lamps, flowers, and <s>candana</s> (sandalwood) — // Rmañj_9.101 //
one should worship for all diseases in the afternoon, with appropriate <s>bali</s>;
everywhere, <s>bali</s>-offerings arise according to the specific name [of the <s>yoginī</s>]. // Rmañj_9.102 //
Chapter 10
Now I shall describe at ease the knowledge of [determining] time [of death] —

children.text: jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ yogī yato jānāti niścayāt // Rmañj_10.1 //
children.translated_text: by which the <s>yogī</s> knows with certainty [whether there will be] life or death. // Rmañj_10.1 //
This world is within the jaws of the <s>graha</s> (seizer) of <s>Kāla</s> (Time/Death) —

children.text: adyaiva vā prabhāte vā so'vaśyaṃ bhaviṣyati // Rmañj_10.2 //
children.translated_text: whether today or tomorrow, it will surely come to pass. // Rmañj_10.2 //

children.text: rasaṃ rasāyanaṃ yogaṃ kālaṃ jñātvā samācaret /
children.translated_text: Having known the [appropriate] time, one should undertake <s>rasa</s> (mercury), <s>rasāyana</s> (rejuvenation), and <s>yoga</s> (formulations);
since without knowledge [of timing] it is futile — therefore this is now declared. // Rmañj_10.3 //

children.text: dūto raktakaṣāyakṛṣṇavasano dantī jarāmarditas tailābhyaktaśarīrakāyudhakaro dīnāśrupūrṇānanaḥ /
children.translated_text: A messenger wearing red, brown, or black garments, with teeth [decayed], tormented by old age, body smeared with oil, carrying weapons, face sorrowful and filled with tears,

children.text: bhasmāṅgārakapālapāṃśumuśalaḥ sūryāstasūryodaye yaḥ sūryasvarasaṃsthito gadavatāṃ kālāya sa syādasau // Rmañj_10.4 //
children.translated_text: [carrying] ash, charcoal, skulls, dust, or a pestle — [arriving] at sunset or sunrise, stationed in the <s>Sūrya</s> (sun) <s>svara</s> (breath) — for the sick person, that [messenger] portends death. // Rmañj_10.4 //
Sudden alteration of mind, sudden [delusion of being] the best among men,
